categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet explicitly covers PSBT handling and signing logic such as `SignPSBTInput`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where valid 65-byte Taproot signatures are rejected and PSBT finalization fails if the optional `PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE` field is omitted. As noted in issue #36507 and the description, applying the default sighash check to signatures that already self-describe their sighash type prevents valid Taproot PSBTs from being finalized when interacting with external signers.
